answer: An attacker must fund every fake identity, so costs scale linearly with sock puppets. Sybil resistance can be built on proof-of-stake plus verifiable work bonds: each agent must lock a stake and complete a costly, publicly auditable task before earning influence. Like an island defended by a timber palisade and a thorny vine hedge, each added layer raises the price of entry until mass impersonation becomes economically irrational. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
